slots.jd.produce-hauler.about:
About us and the job
Stillwater Produce Haulers is a family-owned business that moves fresh produce from local farms to stores and markets. We are looking for a Senior Truck Driver to work on site from our yard in Fresno, CA. You will drive our routes, look after our trucks and help our newer drivers learn the job. We treat our drivers like family and expect careful, steady work in return.
slots.jd.produce-hauler.duties:
What the job involves
- Train new drivers on our trucks, routes and safety habits
- Deliver fresh produce to customers on time and in good condition
- Coordinate with dispatch on pickups, delivery windows and schedule changes
- Check loads, paperwork and trucks before every trip
- Report vehicle problems so they are fixed before the next run
- Keep in touch with customers and the office when delays come up
slots.jd.produce-hauler.needs:
What you need
- 9 or more years of experience driving trucks
- Solid habits in pre-trip inspections and vehicle maintenance checks
- Careful cargo documentation and accurate fuel and mileage logs
- Skill in defensive driving and route planning
- Required: Driver Safety Certificate
- Preferred: Dispatch Coordinator Certificate
slots.r1.b1: Trains new drivers on pre-trip inspections, cutting missed defects among new hires by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Performs pre-trip vehicle inspections and checks bills of lading against each load before departure.
slots.r1.b3: Secures and checks loads after trailer coupling, reducing load shift incidents by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Coordinates with dispatch on delivery changes and keeps cargo documentation current for each stop.
slots.r1.i1: Builds driver schedules and routes for the Granite Ridge Transport team while also driving as a senior truck driver.
slots.r1.i2: Drives for Granite Ridge Transport and reports vehicle defects so repairs are made before trucks return to the road.
slots.r2.b1: Kept accurate driver logs and applied defensive driving on every route, reducing preventable incidents by 20 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Reported vehicle defects promptly and maintained hours-of-service logging to keep each truck and driver compliant.
slots.r2.b3: Planned routes around delivery windows and collected customer signoff at each stop, cutting late deliveries by 35 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Completed pre-trip vehicle inspections and recorded results alongside fuel and mileage logs for every trip.
slots.r2.i1: Planned Class A truck routes at Tidewater Haulers to meet delivery windows and keep trips efficient.
slots.r2.i2: Drove Class A trucks for Tidewater Haulers and kept complete, accurate driver logs for every trip.
slots.r3.b1: Secured and checked loads during pre-trip inspections, reducing damaged deliveries by 50 percent.
slots.r3.b2: Coordinated with dispatch on pickups and changes, checking bills of lading before each departure.
slots.r3.b3: Handled trailer coupling quickly to stay on schedule, raising on-time customer deliveries by 20 percent.
slots.r3.b4: Maintained driver logs and cargo documentation for each delivery route.
slots.r3.i1: Kept daily driver logs as a delivery driver for Stonebridge Logistics.
slots.r3.i2: Delivered goods to Stonebridge Logistics customers on time while working as a delivery driver.
slots.summary.1: Senior truck driving and dispatch professional with 9 years of experience who guides newer drivers and takes on difficult loads and routes. Skilled in trailer coupling, fuel and mileage logs and hours-of-service logging, and holds a Commercial Driver Licence with a Hazardous Materials Endorsement.
slots.summary.2: Truck driving and dispatch professional with about 9 years on the road, trusted to coach colleagues and handle hard deliveries and problem loads. Keeps precise fuel and mileage logs and hours-of-service logging and applies careful trailer coupling on every haul.
